# Customer Assistance

Welcome to the Echo Customs Assistance Centre. If you need help with an order or wish to report a member of our team, please select the appropriate option below.

**{textmessage} Order Assistance**
Need help with an existing order? Whether it's an update, delay, issue or general enquiry, our team is here to help.

**{block} Report a Staff Member**
Had a negative experience with a staff member or have a concern regarding their conduct? Submit a report for management to review.

**{github} Report a Developer / Designer**
Experiencing an issue with a developer or designer, or have a concern regarding their work or conduct? Submit a report for review.

Please ensure you select the correct option and provide accurate details so our team can handle your request appropriately. All reports will be treated confidentially.
